title: Baraat live, ball by ball!
format: Kitty Gang live cricket commentary on the Baraat Aayi game: Megha calls the baraat like a match, each prize group is a ball, and the friend who was not even watching wins Sehra

experiment.hook: Megha shouting into her phone like a cricket commentator on the Baraat Aayi home art, heartbeat at 0 s, mascot ball spinning above, chip 'LIVE: BARAAT AAYI!' pinned from the first frame, she says 'Aur baraat gate pe aa gayi!'
experiment.variable: a known voice that narrates motion instead of hosting: Hindi cricket commentary calls each baraat moment as it happens ('BALL x/3' chips: Ghodi, Naagin Dance, Band Baaja), so every cut is an action with a verdict (out, chhakka, no ball) instead of a host introducing the next guest, at a short length (about 21 s, 9 shots)
experiment.hypothesis: TV-host voices won the hook (45.2 to 47.6% skip) but only the cooking show held the middle (26%); a commentator who gives each cut an instant verdict makes the viewer wait for the next one: skip under 50%, watched % above 24 (best 26), at least 1 share or tag on a Saturday shaadi night from 'jo baraat mein sabse aage naachti hai'

idea: Megha does live cricket commentary as the baraat arrives during the Baraat Aayi Housie: Avika is later than the ghodi (out), Tanya's naagin dance is a chhakka, Shruti wants the band bill rounded off (no ball), then 7 is called and Myra, who was not watching the match at all, wins Sehra.
beats: hook: aur baraat gate pe aa gayi / ball 1/3 Ghodi: Avika late, out / ball 2/3 Naagin Dance: Tanya, chhakka / ball 3/3 Band Baaja: Shruti's round off, no ball / Megha: Sehra, last ball, ek number / the call / reveal: Sehra is Myra's / turn: Myra, tumne toh match dekha hi nahi / button: main toh Housie khel rahi thi
logline: Megha commentates a baraat like a cricket match during the Baraat Aayi Housie, and the new girl who never watched wins the Sehra group.
game: every baraat moment gets a cricket verdict, and the one who ignored the match wins
caption: Aapki baraat mein commentary kaun karti hai? Tag karo! Aaj ki {theme} Housie mein milte hain.

lines.text: Aur baraat gate pe aa gayi!
lines.say: और बारात गेट पे आ गई!

lines.text: Avika ghodi se bhi late. Out!
lines.say: अविका घोड़ी से भी लेट। आउट!

lines.text: Band wale ka bill? Round off nahi!
lines.say: बैंड वाले का बिल? राउंड ऑफ़ नहीं!

lines.text: Sehra group, last ball, ek number!
lines.say: सेहरा ग्रुप, लास्ट बॉल, एक नंबर!

lines.text: Myra? Tumne toh match dekha hi nahi!
lines.say: मायरा? तुमने तो मैच देखा ही नहीं!

lines.text: Match? Main toh Housie khel rahi thi.
lines.say: मैच? मैं तो हाउज़ी खेल रही थी।
